assistant_messages.content:
Here's everything, drawn from your documents.

**1. Invoice approval flow** (diagram 1) — Every invoice follows the same path: AP logs it in the payables register the same working day [3], runs a three-way match against the purchase order and goods receipt note, and any mismatch means rejection — AP emails the supplier the reason, and a rejected invoice is never paid until it's corrected and resubmitted through the match again [3]. Matching invoices go to the budget holder (five working days), then the finance controller only if the invoice exceeds €10,000, and the chain ends with Treasury releasing payment [2]. Approved invoices are scheduled for the weekly run, paid on the Thursday run, and filed for audit for seven years [1]. The escalation loop is built in: a reminder after five working days, and after a second reminder the invoice goes to the head of finance [4] — note also that nobody may approve an invoice they raised themselves [4].

**2. Atlas vs Borealis** (comparison 1) — The key differences: Borealis is far easier to exit (30 days' convenience notice vs Atlas's 90 [11][10]), and it's the counterparty's liability cap that differs most — Atlas's cap floats with fees paid in the prior 12 months, while Borealis is hard-capped at €250,000 per year [10]. Borealis has no renewal clause at all — its fixed two-year term ran 1 June 2024 to 31 May 2026, so it has already ended [10], whereas Atlas auto-renews in one-year terms and is live until 15 March 2027 unless non-renewal notice is given by 15 December 2026 [11].

**3. Atlas timeline** (timeline 1) — The MSA was signed 14 March 2023, services started 1 April 2023, prices rose 3.5% under Amendment 1 in February 2024, an SLA breach notice followed in November 2024 (three missed delivery windows), €18,400 in service credits landed in January 2025, and the annual price uplift of 3.1% took effect 1 April 2026 [6]. The two items to watch are the 15 December 2026 renewal notice deadline and the 15 March 2027 term end [6].

One caveat: all three documents are marked as fixture/test documents generated for Phase 292 UAT with no real parties or amounts, so treat this as process documentation rather than live contract positions.
